CustomField.description: Custom filter conditions evaluated against Case fields only (not child object fields). Supports AND-combined conditions. Any standard or custom field on the Case object can be used — fields are automatically added to the batch query at runtime. To filter on child object fields, use the Child Record Criteria section instead.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Filters on Case fields only. To filter on child object fields, use the Child Record Criteria section above. Enter conditions combined with AND. Syntax: Field = 'Value', Field != 'Value', Field = null, Field != null, Field LIKE 'Pattern%', Field IN ('A','B'), Field NOT IN ('A','B'), Field = true/false. OR is not supported. Use the Case field API name (e.g. Secondary_Call_Reason__c, OwnerId, Priority).
CustomField.label: Additional Filter Logic
